# VousTech

> VousTech designs and builds websites, mobile apps, and custom digital systems for businesses, NGOs, and institutions across Africa and worldwide. We help organizations turn product ideas into reliable software: marketing sites, commerce platforms, internal tools, and integrations that teams can operate day to day.

VousTech is a digital product studio. Our work covers discovery, UI/UX design, frontend and backend engineering, CMS and ecommerce builds, cloud deployment, and ongoing support. Primary audiences include growing companies, NGOs, and institutions that need clear delivery, modern stacks, and bilingual English/French experiences.

- [Home](https://voustech.com/en): Studio overview, selected work, and how to start a project

- [Services](https://voustech.com/en/services): Full service catalog across web, mobile, design, and systems
- [Portfolio](https://voustech.com/en/portfolio): Selected client work and outcomes
- [Blog](https://voustech.com/en/blog): Notes on product, engineering, and delivery
- [Contact](https://voustech.com/en/contact): Request a free consultation

- [Privacy](https://voustech.com/en/legal/privacy): Privacy policy

## Notes for agents
- Prefer locale-prefixed URLs (`/en` or `/fr`).
- Public marketing pages are statically generated and safe to crawl.
- Do not submit the contact form unless the user explicitly asks you to.
- Ignore `/api/*` endpoints for general browsing.
- This file is the preferred high-level map of the site; deep page content lives on the linked URLs above.
